note: Private campground near Drayton Valley in Brazeau County, with the RV sites in a row along the south side of a trout-stocked pond (catch-and-release, barbless hooks) across the loop road. Free kayaks, swimming, a driving range with a three-hole pitch and putt, and an entertainment area with movie nights, darts, ping pong and arcade games. The owners invite guests to bring ATVs to ride the crown land across the range road. The cabins are open all year and the RV and tent sites seasonally. Site water hookups are untreated well water, so bring drinking water. --Claude
